8: ## 1. 目标与固定结论
9: 
10: 目标是在 BK7258 上运行一个 NuttX SMP 实例：物理 CPU1 和 CPU2 共同执行同一个
11: OpenVela `nuttx.bin`，目标 AP 核频率为 480 MHz。物理 CPU0 继续运行 Armino CP，
12: 并继续拥有全芯片电源、DPLL、核心/总线时钟、电压、PSRAM PHY、硬件 WDT 和
13: CPU1 电源生命周期。
14: 
15: 正式架构固定为：
16: 
17: | 物理核 | NuttX 编号 | 角色 | 目标频率 |
18: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
19: | CPU0 | 不可见 | Armino CP，电源/频率执行者 | 240 MHz（480 MHz档位下） |
20: | CPU1 | 0 | OpenVela AP primary、系统 tick、CP transport owner | 480 MHz |
21: | CPU2 | 1 | OpenVela AP secondary、通用 SMP 调度 | 480 MHz |
22: 
23: BK7258 的 `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 不是三核都运行 480 MHz。原厂 HAL 明确配置为：
24: 
25: ```text
26: core source: 480 MHz
27: CPU0:       240 MHz
28: CPU1:       480 MHz
29: CPU2:       480 MHz
30: bus:        240 MHz
31: ```

33: 依据为：

36: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:571-658`

41: 1. 不能只打开 `CONFIG_SMP`。CPU2 reset/vector、核 ID、每核中断栈、IPI、
42:    SMP atomic 和驱动并发都必须实现。
43: 2. 不能只把 AP `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 改为 480 MHz。CP 是共享核心时钟的
44:    唯一执行者，必须在释放 CPU1 reset 前建立 480 MHz vote，并在 AP 停止后释放。
45: 3. 首版 480 MHz SMP 运行期间禁止 runtime DVFS。CPU1/CPU2 的核心时钟变化会直接
46:    改变 SysTick；没有 pre-change/post-change 协议和时间补偿时，运行中改频会破坏

51:    CPU2 只需要同一镜像内的 secondary boot vector。
52: 6. CPU2 启动失败时不得静默降级为单核。`CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2` 下必须 fail-stop，
53:    否则 NuttX per-CPU 和调度器状态不完整。
54: 7. 首版只支持普通 idle WFI。CP coordinated low-voltage、CPU1/CPU2 掉电、CPU2
55:    hotplug 和 runtime DVFS 必须在独立阶段完成，不得和首次 SMP bring-up 混合。

98: ## 3. 已确认的长期重启与频率缺陷
99: 
100: ### 3.1 32 位时间乘法溢出导致 heartbeat 永久阻塞
101: 
102: AP heartbeat worker 位于：
103: 
104: ```c
105: for (;;)
106:   {
107:     nxsig_usleep(2000000);
108:     bk7258_mbox_send_message(... IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ...);
109:   }
110: ```
111: 
112: 来源：
113: 
114: - `contest/.../chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:70-82`
115: 
116: 当前最终配置同时满足：
117: 
118: ```text
119: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
120: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
121: # CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64 is not set
122: ```
123: 
124: NuttX generic architecture timer 使用：
125: 
126: ```c
127: static uint64_t current_usec(void)
128: {
129:   ...
130:   return TICK2USEC(timebase) + (status.timeout - status.timeleft);
131: }
132: ```
133: 
134: `timebase` 是 32 位 `clock_t`，`TICK2USEC` 为：
135: 
136: ```c
137: #define TICK2USEC(tick) ((tick) * USEC_PER_TICK)
138: ```
139: 
140: `1000L` 在 32 位 ARM 上仍为 32 位，因此乘法在转换为 `uint64_t` 之前已经溢出。
141: 编译产物也显示只有低 32 位 `mla`，返回值高 32 位被置零。AP 时间会在：
142: 
143: ```text
144: 2^32 us = 4,294,967.296 ms AP time
145: ```
146: 
147: 提前跳回零，而不是在正常的 32 位 tick 边界回卷。跨界前创建的两秒 sleep deadline
148: 大于这个人为最大值，回卷后的时钟永远到不了 deadline，heartbeat 线程永久阻塞。
149: 
150: CP 的 heartbeat fallback timeout 为 6000 ms。实板多次日志均满足：
151: 
152: ```text
153: current - last_heartbeat = 6000 ms
154: Assert at: mb_ipc_task:298
155: ```
156: 
157: 所以重启是 CP 在 AP heartbeat 停止后执行的确定性断言，不是随机复位。
158: 
159: 必需修复：
160: 
161: ```text
162: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
163: ```
164: 
165: 不能只把 heartbeat 改成 busy wait、分段 sleep 或增大 CP timeout。这些只能隐藏一个
166: 调用者，Mailbox worker、semaphore timeout 和其他 watchdog deadline 仍会失效。
167: 
168: ### 3.2 CP 60 MHz 与 AP 120 MHz 配置不一致
169: 
170: 当前 AP SysTick 使用：
171: 
172: ```c
173: systick_initialize(true, CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ, -1);
174: ```
175: 
176: AP 配置是 120 MHz，但 CP 配置和初始化代码会执行：
177: 
178: ```text
179: CONFIG_CPU_DEFAULT_FREQ_60M=y
180: bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT, PM_CPU_FRQ_60M)
181: ```
182: 
183: 而 60 MHz 档位同时影响 CPU0、CPU1、CPU2 和 bus。结果是 AP 以 120 MHz 计算的
184: 1 ms SysTick 实际约为 2 ms，2 秒 heartbeat 实际约为 4 秒。
185: 
186: 这也精确解释了重启为何发生在约 2 小时 23 分，而不是约 1 小时 11 分：
187: 
188: ```text
189: 4,294.967296 s * (120 / 60) = 8,589.934592 s
190: ```
191: 
192: 实板在约 `8,594.5 s` assert，差值位于最后一帧 heartbeat 到 6 秒 timeout 的窗口。
193: 
194: ### 3.3 CP heartbeat 配置符号错误
195: 
196: CP heartbeat 代码检查 `CONFIG_WDT_EN`，当前生成配置实际使用 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 和
197: `CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS=8000`。所以最终固件走的是 `2000 * 3 = 6000 ms` fallback。
198: 
199: 应将 CP 条件改为实际 watchdog 配置符号，并明确 heartbeat timeout 策略。但即使改成
200: 8 秒，也不能替代 AP 时间和频率修复。

202: ## 4. 电源、频率与核生命周期所有权
203: 
204: ### 4.1 所有权表
205: 
206: | 资源 | 唯一执行者 | OpenVela AP 职责 |
207: | --- | --- | --- |
208: | DPLL/core source/core divider/bus divider | CPU0/CP PM | 只声明固定 480 MHz 契约并校验结果 |
209: | VDDD/VDDDIG 高压档 | CPU0/CP PM | 不直接写 analog/PMU 电压寄存器 |
210: | CPU1 power/reset/boot offset | CPU0/CP | 发送 ready/recovery，不能直接关闭自身 |
211: | CPU2 power domain | CPU0/CP | 请求域保持 ON；不得绕过 CP power accounting |
212: | CPU2 reset/boot offset | CPU1/AP primary | `up_cpu_start(1)` 写 secondary vector 并释放 reset |
213: | CPU2 scheduler/idle/IPI | OpenVela SMP | 完整管理 |
214: | PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟、容量检测 | CPU0/CP | 通过 PWC vote；只管理 AP allocator |
215: | SysTick 和 NuttX monotonic time | CPU1/OpenVela | 固定频率下维护；低压阶段用 AON 时间补偿 |
216: | WDT 和 heartbeat assert | CPU0/CP | AP 持续发送 heartbeat，处理 transport 错误 |

218: ### 4.2 480 MHz 启动时序
219: 
220: CP 必须在释放 CPU1 reset 之前建立 480 MHz，不能等 AP 启动后再通过 PWC 改频：
221: 
222: ```text
223: CP user_app_main
224:   -> vote PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 = PM_CPU_FRQ_480M
225:   -> 验证 PM 当前最大档位 == 480M
226:   -> 验证 CONFIG_CLK_FORCE_MAX_CPU_FREQ_320M 未启用
227:   -> power CPU2 domain ON，CPU2 保持 reset
228:   -> power CPU1 domain ON
229:   -> 设置 CPU1 boot offset
230:   -> release CPU1 reset
231:   -> CPU1 OpenVela 按 480 MHz 初始化 SysTick
232:   -> nx_smp_start()
233:   -> CPU1 设置 CPU2 secondary vector并release CPU2 reset
234:   -> CPU2 online和双向IPI自检
235:   -> AP power-up/heartbeat/PWC ready
236: ```
237: 
238: CP 侧建议增加显式配置 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M`，只在外部 OpenVela AP 构建中启用，
239: 避免改变原厂 FreeRTOS AP 的默认行为。该配置下修改：
240: 
241: - `projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c`：`user_app_main()` 在调用
242:   `bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP, ON)` 前先执行
243:   `bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1, PM_CPU_FRQ_480M)`。
244: - `cp/components/bk_init/bk_init.c:372-374`：`CONFIG_CPU_DEFAULT_FREQ_60M` 分支
245:   必须在 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` 启用时跳过，否则 `PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT` 的 60 MHz
246:   vote 会与 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 的 480 MHz vote 并存。由于 PM 取所有 module 的最大值，
247:   480 MHz 仍会胜出，但 60 MHz vote 会保留在 vote 表中，AP 停止后若 480 MHz vote
248:   被释放，共享时钟会立即跌回 60 MHz 而非正常档位。
249: - `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c`：`pm_module_bootup_cpu1()` 在
250:   `bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, ON)` 之前插入
251:   `bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1, PM_CPU_FRQ_480M)`，确保升压和切频
252:   在 CPU1 上电前完成。验证 `bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get()` 返回 480 MHz 后再
253:   `start_cpu1_core()`。

271: ### 4.3 运行期频率规则
272: 
273: 首版运行期规则只有一条：AP online 时 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 始终 vote 480 MHz。
274: 
275: - CP 默认 60 MHz vote可以保留；PM 取所有 module vote 的最大值，AP lifetime vote 会
276:   把共享时钟保持在 480 MHz。
277: - AP 不发送 `PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD` 降频。
278: - 其他 CP/AP module 可以投票，但不能把最大值降到 480 MHz以下。
279: - CP 应提供诊断查询，至少输出 current max vote、vote owner、core source、CPU0/CPU1
280:   divider、bus divider和 VDDDIG readback。
281: - `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 被 `CONFIG_CLK_FORCE_MAX_CPU_FREQ_320M` 截断时必须判为启动失败，
282:   不能继续用 480 MHz SysTick配置运行。
283: 
284: 建议扩展双方一致的 `PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD` enum，增加只读的 current frequency 与 divider
285: 查询。扩展必须同时更新 AP/CP header 和 source override，不能单边复用已有 enum 数值。
286: 
287: ### 4.4 关闭与故障回滚
288: 
289: 正常关闭或 AP recovery 的顺序必须是：
290: 
291: ```text
292: AP primary停止新任务和外设提交
293:   -> quiesce PSRAM/DMA/Mailbox UART
294:   -> 调度CPU2执行stop callback
295:   -> 屏蔽CPU2普通IRQ和IPI
296:   -> CPU2进入确认的park/WFI状态
297:   -> CPU1将CPU2置reset
298:   -> AP向CP回复recovery-ready
299:   -> CP停止CPU1
300:   -> CP关闭CPU2 power domain
301:   -> CP关闭CPU1 power domain
302:   -> CP释放PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 480 MHz vote
303: ```
304: 
305: 当前 CP shutdown 代码仅在特定低压配置下才停止 CPU2，而且顺序是先停止 CPU1、后停止
306: CPU2。OpenVela SMP 模式必须改成上述顺序。CPU2 仍在执行共享 NuttX 状态时，CP 不能
307: 直接关闭 CPU2 power；CPU1 已停止后也不能再依赖 CPU1 去 park CPU2。
308: 
309: CPU1 启动超时、CPU2 online 超时或 480 MHz readback失败都必须走同一回滚路径。
310: 
311: ## 5. 睡眠与低功耗分阶段方案
312: 
313: ### 5.1 阶段 P0：普通 WFI，禁止 coordinated low-voltage
314: 
315: 首次 SMP 和 480 MHz 验收只启用 per-core 普通 WFI：
316: 
317: - CPU1/CPU2 idle 时可执行 `WFI`，但不能设置 CP coordinated low-voltage 的 AP
318:   ready bits。
319: - CP 必须保持 `PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1` 为 exit-sleep 状态，因此全芯片 low-voltage
320:   条件不成立。
321: - 保持 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 关闭。
322: - 不支持 CPU1/CPU2 power-down、retention、CPU2 hotplug 或 tickless。
323: - heartbeat、Mailbox 和 SysTick 在普通 WFI 下仍可唤醒 CPU1。
324: 
325: CP 的 `PM_ENTER_LOW_VOL_MODULES_CONFIG` 包含 `PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`。启动 OpenVela
326: AP 时应显式清除此 sleep vote，不能依赖 BSS 初值。这样 CP 在 AP 未实现低压协议前只能
327: 进入 normal sleep，不会误把运行中的 NuttX SMP 带入全芯片 low-voltage。
328: 
329: ### 5.2 阶段 P1：双核 coordinated low-voltage
330: 
331: 只有 P0 的 24 小时稳定性通过后，才能实现原厂 AP 的等价低压协议。原厂事实为：
332: 
333: - CP 要求 CPU1 和 CPU2 都进入 WFI，并检查 AON PMU 的
334:   `cp1_enter_wfi_state`、`cp2_enter_wfi_state`。
335: - AP 两个核分别屏蔽普通 IRQ，只保留本核 Mailbox wakeup。
336: - CP 保存并切换核心/Flash 时钟，恢复 DPLL 后再唤醒 AP。
337: - 原 AP 依赖 FreeRTOS SMP idle 和 `vPortYieldCore()`；这些调用不能直接移植到 NuttX。
338: 
339: NuttX 实现必须包含：
340: 
341: 1. CPU0 owner 发起 PM barrier，禁止新 SMP call、任务迁移、DMA 和 mailbox transaction。
342: 2. 两核运行 per-CPU prepare callback，保存本核 NVIC/SysTick状态。
343: 3. CPU2 设置 `cp2_enter_wfi_state` 后进入 WFI；CPU1确认 CPU2已就绪。
344: 4. CPU1停止 SysTick，设置 `cp1_enter_wfi_state`，通过既有 sleep vote允许 CP 进入低压。
345: 5. CP 只在两个 AON WFI bit、AP sleep/clock vote和 mailbox idle 都满足后切换低压。
346: 6. CP 恢复 DPLL、480 MHz档位和 bus 后，通过 Mailbox 唤醒 AP。
347: 7. CPU1读取 AON RTC elapsed time，恢复 monotonic time和 SysTick；再唤醒 CPU2。
348: 8. 两核恢复 NVIC和驱动 callback，解除 PM barrier并恢复heartbeat。
349: 
350: 低压时间基准不能继续完全依赖 core-clock SysTick。推荐增加 BK7258 strong
351: `up_timer_gettick()`/`up_timer_gettime()`，以 AON RTC 构建 64 位单调时间；SysTick只负责
352: 产生调度中断。这样核心时钟暂停后，下一次 tick仍能看到真实 elapsed time并处理到期
353: watchdog。AON RTC wrap扩展、单位换算和并发读取必须使用64位并有实板校准。
354: 
355: 在 AON-backed monotonic time、双核 barrier和驱动 PM callback完成前，禁止打开 P1。
356: 
357: ### 5.3 Deep sleep
358: 
359: Deep sleep定义为 AP 上下文丢失后的完整重启，不是 NuttX suspend-to-RAM：
360: 
361: - CPU1/CPU2、NuttX heap、scheduler、Mailbox transport和PSRAM对象均视为丢失。
362: - CP/bootloader重新启动 CPU1，CPU1重新启动 CPU2。
363: - PSRAM generation必须变化，旧对象不可复用。
364: - 不承诺从原 PC/任务现场继续运行。
365: 
366: ## 6. NuttX SMP 芯片层实现
367: 
368: ### 6.1 配置硬门禁
369: 
370: AP defconfig目标配置：
371: 
372: ```text
373: CONFIG_ARCH_HAVE_MULTICPU=y
374: CONFIG_SMP=y
375: CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2
376: CONFIG_SMP_DEFAULT_CPUSET=0x3
377: CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK=2048
378: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
379: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
380: CONFIG_ARMV8M_SYSTICK=y
381: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
382: CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000
383: # CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS is not set
384: ```
385: 
386: `ARCH_CHIP_BK7258` 增加：
387: 
388: ```kconfig
389: select ARCH_HAVE_MULTICPU
390: select LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK if SMP
391: ```
392: 
393: `board/beken/chips/bk7258/Kconfig:15-17` 的 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 默认值从
394: `120000000` 改为 `480000000`。`bk7258_timerisr.c:16` 直接引用该宏传递给
395: `systick_initialize()`，无需额外修改 timerisr 源码。
396: 
397: 最终 `.config` 必须确认 `clock_t` 为64位、toolchain atomic没有绕过 BK7258 backend、
398: CPU数为2。禁止只修改生成的 `.config`；必须修改项目 defconfig并执行 distclean。
399: 
400: ### 6.2 文件与构建接入
401: 
402: 建议最小新增：
403: 
404: ```text
405: chips/bk7258/
406:   bk7258_cpustart.c       # secondary vector、reset、online handshake
407:   bk7258_cpuindex.c       # logical CPU ID
408:   bk7258_cpuidlestack.c   # secondary idle stack
409:   bk7258_smpcall.c        # raw Mailbox IPI
410:   bk7258_hwspinlock.c     # AP_SPINLOCK software gate
411:   bk7258_atomic.c         # g_atomic_hwspinlock
412: ```
413: 
414: 修改：
415: 
416: ```text
417: Kconfig
418: CMakeLists.txt
419: Make.defs
420: bk7258_start.c
421: bk7258_vectors.c
422: bk7258_irq.c
423: bk7258_timerisr.c
424: bk7258_mbox0.c
425: bk7258_mailbox_channel.c
426: hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h
427: hardware/bk7258_mbox.h
428: board scripts/ld.script
429: board configs/nsh/defconfig
430: ```
431: 
432: Make和CMake必须包含同一组SMP源文件，并仅在 `CONFIG_SMP` 下编译专用对象。
433: 
434: ### 6.3 CPU ID
435: 
436: 原厂 AP 使用每核私有 DTCM地址 `0x20000000` 保存 AP逻辑核 ID。OpenVela采用：
437: 
438: ```text
439: 物理CPU1私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU0
440: 物理CPU2私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU1
441: ```
442: 
443: `up_cpu_index()` 直接读取该word。primary在任何 per-CPU/NuttX atomic调用前写0；
444: secondary在任何NuttX API前写1。必须实板验证两核看到的是私有实例，不是共享word。
445: 
446: ### 6.4 内存、secondary vector和栈
447: 
448: 分区保持：
449: 
450: ```text
451: AP_SPINLOCK  0x28000000..0x2800ffff
452: AP_RAM       0x28010000..0x28063fff
453: CP_RAM       0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
454: PWR_MNG      0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
455: SWAP         0x2809f800..0x2809ffff
456: ```
457: 
458: CPU2不增加Flash/RAM分区。链接脚本增加：
459: 
460: - `SPINLOCK` MEMORY，绝不加入heap。
461: - 512字节对齐的 `.bk_secondary_vectors`。
462: - 只用于reset早期的CPU2 bootstrap stack。
463: - 两份静态 interrupt stack，或等价的每核固定中断栈区域。
464: - 全部边界和对齐 `ASSERT`。
465: 
466: secondary vector：
467: 
468: ```text
469: word 0: CPU2 bootstrap MSP top
470: word 1: bk7258_secondary_start | 1
471: ```
472: 
473: CPU2 boot offset寄存器只保存地址高24位，至少要求256字节对齐；统一采用512字节以
474: 满足VTOR约束。secondary vector不包含primary image offset `0x100` 的BK legacy magic。
475: 
476: `up_cpu_idlestack()` 应像 RP2040 一样调用 `up_create_stack()`，初始化 logical CPU1
477: idle TCB。CPU2 reset后先用bootstrap MSP；进入NuttX前将 PSP切到 idle TCB stack top，
478: MSP切到 logical CPU1 interrupt stack，并设置 PSPLIM/MSPLIM。两个核不得共用MSP。
479: 
480: ### 6.5 CPU2启动
481: 
482: `up_cpu_start(1)`：
483: 
484: ```text
485: 校验cpu==1且当前为logical CPU0
486:   -> 确认CP已保持CPU2 power domain ON
487:   -> 确认480 MHz契约和channel 2已配置
488:   -> 发布idle PSP、interrupt MSP、runtime VTOR
489:   -> 清boot stage/online flag，DMB/DSB
490:   -> CPU2保持reset时清route/pending
491:   -> CPU2_PWR_DW=0
492:   -> CPU2_RXEVT_SEL=1
493:   -> CPU2_OFFSET=secondary_vector>>8
494:   -> CPU2_SW_RST=1
495:   -> 有界等待online和双向IPI自检
496: ```
497: 
498: 超时建议500 ms，输出CPU2 control、run status、route、NVIC、Mailbox channel 2、boot
499: stage和当前频率readback，然后panic。不能只返回错误后继续 `nx_bringup()`。
500: 
501: `bk7258_secondary_start()` 只初始化每核私有状态：
502: 
503: - logical ID、FPU CP10/11和barrier。
504: - 与primary一致的SAU/MPU/VTOR。
505: - CPU2私有NVIC enable/pending/priority。
506: - CPU2 Mailbox route和IRQ79。
507: - PSP/MSP/stack limit。
508: - online flag、`sched_note_cpu_started()`、`nx_idle_trampoline()`。
509: 
510: secondary禁止复制 `.data`、清 `.bss`、初始化heap/PSRAM/driver、调用 `nx_start()`、
511: 初始化第二个SysTick或重置全局Mailbox FIFO。
512: 
513: ### 6.6 每核MPU/NVIC
514: 
515: MPU、SAU、NVIC、VTOR、SysTick和FPU控制均为每核私有。CPU2必须安装与CPU1相同的：
516: 
517: - AP Flash RO/X。
518: - AP RAM RW/XN/shareable。
519: - `AP_SPINLOCK` RW/XN/non-cacheable/shareable。
520: - CP共享窗口和Mailbox UART override。
521: - PSRAM 16 MiB RW/XN/non-cacheable。
522: - peripheral Device/XN。
523: 
524: 当前 CPU1 使用7个 MPU region；增加 AP_SPINLOCK 后至少需要8个，启动时继续读
525: `MPU_TYPE.DREGION`并 fail-stop。CPU2不能重复probe或初始化PSRAM allocator。
526: 
527: 全局NuttX IRQ table只由primary初始化一次。CPU2只初始化私有NVIC和CPU2 route：
528: 
529: ```text
530: CPU1 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010088 / 0x4401008c
531: CPU2 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010090 / 0x44010094
532: ```
533: 
534: 首版只有CPU2 Mailbox IPI路由到CPU2。GPIO、PWM、I2C、QSPI、camera、Wi-Fi和其他
535: 有状态外设仍由logical CPU0 owner。
536: 
537: ## 7. Mailbox IPI与CP transport共存
538: 
539: ### 7.1 物理channel
540: 
541: | channel | owner | FIFO |
542: | ---: | --- | --- |
543: | 0 | CPU0/CP | start 0, length 2 |
544: | 1 | CPU1/AP primary | start 2, length 3 |
545: | 2 | CPU2/AP secondary | start 5, length 3 |
546: 
547: 沿用原厂消息分类：
548: 
549: ```text
550: data[1] != 0: pointer + length envelope，进入CP/AP logical transport
551: data[1] == 0: AP内部raw command，进入SMP IPI handler
552: ```
553: 
554: CPU2不处理CP PWC、heartbeat、Wi-Fi或Mailbox UART envelope。CP transport始终由
555: logical CPU0负责。
556: 
557: ### 7.2 当前初始化路径的改造
558: 
559: 当前 physical Mailbox 已在 `arm_serialinit()` 中经：
560: 
561: ```text
562: bk7258_mailbox_init()
563: bk7258_mb_uart_init()
564: bk7258_mailbox_start()
565: ```
566: 
567: 启动。这发生在 `nx_smp_start()` 之前，生命周期适合SMP。改造要求：
568: 
569: 1. primary physical start一次性配置channel 1和2 FIFO，不能在CPU2 online后soft reset。
570: 2. 全局 `irq_attach(79, ...)` 只执行一次；CPU2复用共享NuttX IRQ handler table，但启用
571:    自己的route和私有NVIC line 63。
572: 3. ISR按 `up_cpu_index()` 选择本核physical channel。
573: 4. channel 1可处理CP envelope和raw IPI；channel 2只接受raw IPI。
574: 5. shared transport状态从仅 `up_irq_save()` 改为SMP spinlock，或严格固定到CPU0。
575: 
576: ### 7.3 NuttX SMP hooks
577: 
578: 实现：
579: 
580: ```c
581: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu);
582: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset);
583: ```
584: 
585: raw command采用pending bitmap合并 `SCHED`、`CALL`和 `PM`。发送前DMB，ISR读取并清
586: pending后DMB，然后调用：
587: 
588: ```c
589: nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, arg);
590: nxsched_process_delivered(this_cpu());
591: ```
592: 
593: FIFO full不能静默丢失。采用“shared pending bit + kick”语义：消息只负责唤醒，真实
594: 工作由pending bit保持；如果目标已有未处理kick，不重复占FIFO。发送失败需要有界重试、
595: 计数和fatal门限，禁止持有目标ISR需要的spinlock时无限等待。
596: 
597: ## 8. Atomic、spinlock和共享驱动
598: 
599: ### 8.1 BK7258约束
600: 
601: 原厂注释明确：BK7258 AP SMP只有两个exclusive monitor；两个CPU同时对普通SRAM做
602: exclusive访问时，第三方DMA/Audio写SRAM可能无提示失败。因此原厂把所有spinlock对象
603: 集中在 `AP_SPINLOCK` 特殊SRAM区。
604: 
605: `AP_SPINLOCK`不是寄存器型硬件spinlock。首版使用一个位于该区的software gate，
606: 通过LDAXR/STXR仲裁所有NuttX `__atomic_*` fallback：
607: 
608: ```text
609: CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK=y
610: g_atomic_hwspinlock -> BK7258 software gate
611: ```
612: 
613: gate owner使用 `logical_cpu + 1`，0表示free，避免CPU0 owner和free混淆。trylock使用
614: acquire exclusive，unlock使用release store、DSB和SEV。primary在进入 `nx_start()` 前
615: 初始化gate；CPU2启动后禁止再次清零。
616: 
617: 这会串行化NuttX atomic，性能不是目标，正确性是目标。只有DMA/Audio/exclusive压力
618: 通过后才能评估更细粒度方案。
619: 
620: ### 8.2 驱动收敛
621: 
622: 首版将以下worker和IRQ固定到logical CPU0：
623: 
624: - Mailbox transport/UART/syslog/PWC/heartbeat。
625: - Wi-Fi、camera、QSPI、DMA和媒体worker。
626: - GPIO、button/motor、PWM、I2C。
627: - 所有未完成SMP审计的board driver。
628: 
629: `kthread_create()` 后立即 `sched_setaffinity(mask=0x1)`；失败则该driver bring-up失败。
630: 
631: 即使worker固定CPU0，CPU2任务仍可能调用公共API。以下共享状态必须使用
632: `spin_lock_irqsave()` 或mutex：
633: 
634: - Mailbox active transaction、ACK pool、recovery epoch和ring index。
635: - syslog/serial TX/RX ring。
636: - GPIO/PWM/I2C寄存器RMW。
637: - PSRAM allocator状态、allocation counters和generation。
638: - Wi-Fi command/data slot和pbuf ownership。
639: 
640: ISR共享短状态使用spinlock；会等待ACK、semaphore、内存或格式化日志的路径使用mutex，
641: 禁止在spinlock内sleep。
642: 
643: ## 9. 系统tick、heartbeat与时间正确性
644: 
645: 首版只有logical CPU0启动SysTick。CPU2不得调用 `up_timer_initialize()`，否则系统时间
646: 和RR accounting加倍。CPU0每tick调用NuttX timer处理，调度器通过IPI要求CPU2切换。
647: 
648: 必须满足：
649: 
650: - `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`。
651: - CPU1实际频率和 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000` 一致。
652: - 60秒wall clock测试误差在晶振/调度允许范围内，不能出现2倍或1/2倍。
653: - heartbeat实际周期约2秒，不是4秒。
654: - heartbeat发送返回值必须检查并统计 `-EBUSY`、`-ENOLINK`、timeout。
655: - CP heartbeat使用实际 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 配置；timeout至少容纳调度抖动和一次transport
656:   recovery，但不能用增大timeout掩盖lost heartbeat。
657: 
658: 长期测试必须跨越旧故障边界：至少运行3小时；正式验收运行24小时。还应通过调试构建
659: 把timer timebase置于旧的 `UINT32_MAX / 1000` 边界前，快速验证sleep跨界。
660: 
661: ## 10. 分阶段实施
662: 
663: ### S0：先修复单核时间和480 MHz契约
664: 
665: 1. AP defconfig 增加 `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`，保持单核 `CONFIG_SMP` 关闭。
666: 2. AP `Kconfig` 将 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 默认值改为 `480000000`。
667: 3. CP 增加 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M`，在 `pm_module_bootup_cpu1()` 中于上电前 vote
668:    `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 = PM_CPU_FRQ_480M`，并在 `bk_init.c` 中条件跳过 60 MHz 默认 vote。
669: 4. CP 修正 `mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` 的 watchdog 配置符号从 `CONFIG_WDT_EN` 改为实际
670:    `CONFIG_INT_WDT`，使 timeout 正确反映 `CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS`。
671: 5. 增加 CP frequency/divider/voltage readback 诊断和 AP heartbeat send 错误统计。
672: 6. AP heartbeat worker 检查 `bk7258_mbox_send_message()` 返回值，记录 `-EBUSY`、
673:    `-ENOLINK` 和 transport timeout 计数。
674: 
675: 退出条件：20次冷启动、60秒时间校准、3小时静置无heartbeat timeout；CP日志确认
676: CPU0=240、CPU1/CPU2=480、bus=240 MHz档位。
677: 
678: ### S1：SMP编译与内存骨架
679: 
680: 1. 打开SMP配置，增加CPU ID、每核interrupt stack、secondary idle stack。
681: 2. 增加SPINLOCK MEMORY和atomic backend。
682: 3. 增加secondary vector和链接断言，暂不release CPU2。
683: 4. 两核MPU表增加AP_SPINLOCK和相同PSRAM属性。
684: 
685: 退出条件：clean build通过；map、vector、stack、gate和heap边界全部正确。
686: 
687: ### S2：CPU2启动到idle
688: 
689: 1. CP在OpenVela AP生命周期内保持CPU2 power domain ON/reset。
690: 2. 实现CPU2 reset、private arch init、stack切换和online handshake。
691: 3. CPU2只运行NuttX idle，不路由普通外设。
692: 
693: 退出条件：100次冷启动，CPU2每次500 ms内online；任何失败都fail-stop且有寄存器诊断。
694: 
695: ### S3：IPI与调度
696:

131: /****************************************************************************
132:  * Name: up_cpu_start
133:  *
134:  * Description:
135:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
136:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion of
137:  *   the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal multitasking,
138:  *   the additional CPUs would be started by calling this function.
139:  *
140:  *   Each CPU is provided the entry point to its IDLE task when started.  A
141:  *   TCB for each CPU's IDLE task has been initialized and placed in the
142:  *   CPU's g_assignedtasks[cpu] list.  No stack has been allocated or
143:  *   initialized.

145:  *   The OS initialization logic calls this function repeatedly until each
146:  *   CPU has been started, 1 through (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
147:  *

27: static inline void bk7258_route_irq(int extirq, bool enable)
28: {
29:   uintptr_t regaddr;
30:   uint32_t bit;
31: 
32:   if (extirq < 32)
33:     {
34:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0;
35:       bit = 1u << extirq;
36:     }
37:   else
38:     {
39:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1;
40:       bit = 1u << (extirq - 32);
41:     }
42: 
43:   if (enable)
44:     {
45:       modifyreg32(regaddr, 0, bit);
46:     }
47:   else
48:     {
49:       modifyreg32(regaddr, bit, 0);
50:     }
51: }

53: static int bk7258_irqinfo(int irq, uintptr_t *regaddr, uint32_t *bit,
54:                           uintptr_t offset)
55: {
56:   int extirq;
57: 
58:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_NMI && irq < NR_IRQS);
59: 
60:   if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
61:     {
62:       extirq = irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
63:       *regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_ENABLE(extirq) + offset;
64:       *bit = 1u << (extirq & 31);
65:       return OK;
66:     }
67: 
68:   *regaddr = NVIC_SYSHCON;
69:   switch (irq)
70:     {
71:       case BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT:
72:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA;
73:         break;
74:       case BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT:
75:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA;
76:         break;
77:       case BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT:
78:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA;
79:         break;
80:       case BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT:
81:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_SECUREFAULTENA;
82:         break;
83:       case BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK:
84:         *regaddr = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL;

143:  * strex performs a conditional store to the memory, succeeding only if the target location is tagged
144:  * as being monitored for exclusive access by that core. this instruction returns non-zero in the

153: static inline int __spin_lock(volatile spinlock_t *lock)
154: {
155: 	uint32_t core_id;
156: 	int status = 0;
157: 
158: 	// Note: The core IDs are the full 32 bit (CORE_ID_REGVAL_PRO/CORE_ID_REGVAL_APP) values
159: 	core_id = portGET_CORE_ID();
160: 
161: 	// The caller is already the owner of the lock. Simply increment the nesting count
162: 	if (lock->owner == core_id)
163: 	{
164: 		BK_ASSERT(lock->count > 0 && lock->count < 0xFF);	  // Bad count value implies memory corruption
165: 		lock->count ++;
166: 		return 1;
167: 	}
168: 
169: 	do
170: 	{
171: 		// Note: __LDAEX and __STREXW are CMSIS functions
172: 
173: 		while (__LDAEX(&lock->owner) != SPIN_LOCK_FREE)
174: 		{
175: 			__WFE();
176: 		}
177: 
178: 		BK_ASSERT((core_id == 0) || (core_id  == 1));
179: 
180: 		// lock is free
181: 		status = __STREXW(core_id, &lock->owner); // Try to set
182: 
183: 	} while (status != 0); // retry until lock successfully
184: 
185: 	lock->count ++;
186: 
187: 	return 1;
188: }

202: 		lock->count ++;

204: 	}
205: 
206: 	// Note: __LDAEX and __STREXW are CMSIS functions
207: 
208: 	if (__LDAEX(&lock->owner) != SPIN_LOCK_FREE)
209: 	{
210: 		return 0;
211: 	}
212: 
213: 	BK_ASSERT((core_id == 0) || (core_id  == 1));
214: 	// lock is free

216:

319: Tickless Imported Interfaces
320: ----------------------------
321: 
322: The interfaces that must be provided by the platform specified
323: code are defined in ``include/nuttx/arch.h``, listed below, and
324: summarized in the following paragraphs:
325: 
326:   - ``<arch>_timer_initialize()`` Initializes
327:     the timer facilities. Called early in the initialization
328:     sequence (by ``up_initialize()``).
329:   - ``up_timer_gettime()``: Returns the
330:     current time from the platform specific time source.
331: 
332: The tickless option can be supported either via a simple interval
333: timer (plus elapsed time) or via an alarm. The interval timer
334: allows programming events to occur after an interval. With the
335: alarm, you can set a time in\* the future and get an event when
336: that alarm goes off.
337: 
338: If ``CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS_ALARM`` is defined, then the platform
339: code must provide the following:
340: 
341: -  ``up_alarm_cancel()``: Cancels the alarm.
342: -  ``up_alarm_start()``: Enables (or
343:    re-enables) the alarm.
344: 
345: If ``CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS_ALARM`` is *not*\ defined, then the
346: platform code must provide the following verify similar functions:
347: 
348: -  ``up_timer_cancel()``: Cancels the
349:    interval timer.
350: -  ``up_timer_start()``: Starts (or re-starts)
351:    the interval timer.
352: 
353: Note that a platform-specific implementation would probably require two
354: hardware timers: (1) A interval timer to satisfy the requirements of
355: ``up_timer_start()`` and ``up_timer_cancel()``, and (2) a counter to
356: handle the requirement of ``up_timer_gettime()``. Ideally, both timers
357: would run at the rate determined by ``CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK`` (and
358: certainly never slower than that rate).
359: 
360: Since timers are a limited resource, the use of two timers could be an
361: issue on some systems. The job could be done with a single timer if, for
362: example, the single timer were kept in a free-running mode at all times.
363: Some timer/counters have the capability to generate a compare interrupt
364: when the timer matches a comparison value but also to continue counting
365: without stopping. If your hardware supports such counters, one might use
366: the ``CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS_ALARM`` option and be able to simply set the
367: comparison count at the value of the free running timer *PLUS* the
368: desired delay. Then you could have both with a single timer: An alarm
369: and a free-running counter with the same timer!
370: 
371: In addition to these imported interfaces, the RTOS will export the
372: following interfaces for use by the platform-specific interval
373: timer implementation:

375: - ``nxsched_alarm_expiration()``: called by the platform-specific logic when the alarm expires.
376: - ``nxsched_timer_expiration()``: called by the platform-specific logic when the interval time expires.

142:  *   spinlock is successfully locked.

145:  *   it does not perform instrumentation logic.

159: #ifdef CONFIG_SPINLOCK
160: static inline_function noinstrument_function
161: void spin_lock_notrace(FAR volatile spinlock_t *lock)
162: {
163: #ifdef CONFIG_TICKET_SPINLOCK
164:   int ticket = atomic_add_relaxed(&lock->next, 1);
165:   while (atomic_read_acquire(&lock->owner) != ticket);
166: #else /* CONFIG_TICKET_SPINLOCK */
167:   while (atomic_xchg_acquire(&lock->lock, 1) == 1);
168: #endif
169: }
170: #else
171: #  define spin_lock_notrace(lock) ((void)(lock))
172: #endif /* CONFIG_SPINLOCK */

174: /****************************************************************************
175:  * Name: spin_lock
176:  *
177:  * Description:
178:  *   If this CPU does not already hold the spinlock, then loop until the
179:  *   spinlock is successfully locked.
180:  *
181:  *   This implementation is non-reentrant and is prone to deadlocks in
182:  *   the case that any logic on the same CPU attempts to take the lock
183:  *   more than once.
184:  *
185:  * Input Parameters:
186:  *   lock - A reference to the spinlock object to lock.
187:  *
188:  * Returned Value:
189:  *   None.  When the function returns, the spinlock was successfully locked
190:  *   by this CPU.
191:  *
192:  * Assumptions:
193:  *   Not running at the interrupt level.
194:  *
195:  ****************************************************************************/
196: 
197: #ifdef CONFIG_SPINLOCK
198: static inline_function void spin_lock(FAR volatile spinlock_t *lock)
199: {
200:   /* Mark that we want to hold lock */
201: 
202:   spinlock_mark_locking(&lock->info);
203: 
204:   /* Notify that we are waiting for a spinlock */
205: 
206:   sched_note_spinlock(lock, NOTE_SPINLOCK_LOCK);
207: 
208:   /* If CONFIG_SCHED_CRITMONITOR_MAXTIME_BUSYWAIT >= 0, count busy-waiting. */
209: 
210:   nxsched_critmon_busywait(true, return_address(0));
211: 
212:   /* Lock without trace note */
213: 
214:   spin_lock_notrace(lock);
215: 
216:   /* Mark the spinlock has been locked */
217: 
218:   spinlock_mark_locked(&lock->info);
219: 
220:   /* Get the lock, end counting busy-waiting */
221: 
222:   nxsched_critmon_busywait(false, return_address(0));
223: 
224:   /* Notify that we have the spinlock */
225: 
226:   sched_note_spinlock(lock, NOTE_SPINLOCK_LOCKED);
227: }
228: #else
229: #  define spin_lock(lock) ((void)(lock))
230: #endif /* CONFIG_SPINLOCK */

234:  *
235:  * Description:
236:  *   Try once to lock the spinlock.  Do not wait if the spinlock is already
237:  *   locked.
238:  *
239:  *   This implementation is the same as the above spin_trylock() except that
240:  *   it does not perform instrumentation logic.
241:  *
242:  * Input Parameters:
243:  *   lock - A reference to the spinlock object to lock.
244:  *
245:  * Returned Value:
246:  *   false - Failure, the spinlock was already locked
247:  *   true  - Success, the spinlock was successfully locked
248:  *
249:  * Assumptions:
250:  *   Not running at the interrupt level.
251:  *
252:  ****************************************************************************/
253: 
254: #ifdef CONFIG_SPINLOCK
255: static inline_function noinstrument_function bool
256: spin_trylock_notrace(FAR volatile spinlock_t *lock)
257: {
258: #ifdef CONFIG_TICKET_SPINLOCK

10: #include <string.h>
11:

13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: 
15: #include "arm_internal.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "irq.h"
19: 
20: #define MBOX_REG(n)             (BK7258_MBOX0_BASE + ((n) * 4u))
21: #define MBOX_CH1_CFG            MBOX_REG(0x20)
22: #define MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG       MBOX_REG(0x21)
23: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA0         MBOX_REG(0x22)
24: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x23)
25: #define MBOX_CH1_TID            MBOX_REG(0x24)
26: #define MBOX_CH1_SID            MBOX_REG(0x25)
27: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA0         MBOX_REG(0x26)
28: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x27)
29: #define MBOX_CH1_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x28)
30: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x18)
31: #define MBOX_CH2_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x38)
32: #define MBOX_CTRL               MBOX_REG(2)
33: 
34: #define MBOX_CFG_INT_EN         (1u << 8)
35: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN       (1u << 9)
36: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN       (1u << 10)
37: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN      (1u << 11)
38: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS   (1u << 16)
39: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS   (1u << 17)
40: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS  (1u << 18)
41: #define MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS   (MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS | \
42:                                  MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS | \
43:                                  MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS)
44: #define MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK        0x00000fffu
45: 
46: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
47: 
48: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
49: {
50:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
51:   uint32_t order;
52:   bool used;
53: };
54: 
55: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
56: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
57: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
58: static uint32_t g_processing_order;
59: static bool g_mbox_ready;
60: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
61: 
62: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
63:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
64: 
65: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
66: {
67:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
68: }
69: 
70: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)
71: {
72:   uint32_t config = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_CFG);
73:   uint32_t errors = config & MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
74: 
75:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
76:     {
77:       g_stats.write_error++;
78:     }
79: 
80:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
81:     {
82:       g_stats.read_error++;
83:     }
84: 
85:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
86:     {
87:       g_stats.write_full++;
88:     }
89: 
90:   if (errors != 0)
91:     {
92:       putreg32((config & MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
93:     }
94: }
95: 
96: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
97:                                 uint32_t length)
98: {
99:   if (source != 0)
100:     {
101:       g_stats.bad_source++;
102:       return false;
103:     }
104: 
105:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
106:     {
107:       g_stats.bad_length++;
108:       return false;
109:     }
110: 
111:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
112:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
113:     {
114:       g_stats.bad_address++;
115:       return false;
116:     }
117: 
118:   return true;
119: }
120: 
121: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
122: {
123:   uintptr_t status;
124: 
125:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
126:     {
127:       return -EINVAL;
128:     }
129: 
130:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
131:    * receive FIFO status register.
132:    */
133: 
134:   status = destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
135:            destination == 1 ? MBOX_CH1_STATUS : MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
136:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
137:     {
138:       return -EAGAIN;
139:     }
140: 
141:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
142:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
143:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
144:   return OK;
145: }
146: 
147: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
148: {
149:   unsigned int i;
150: 
151:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
152:     {
153:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
154:         {
155:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
156:         }
157:     }
158: 
159:   return NULL;
160: }
161: 
162: static bool mbox_priority_message(
163:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
164: {
165:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
166: 
167:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
168: }
169: 
170: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
171: {
172:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
173:   unsigned int i;
174: 
175:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
176:     {
177:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
178: 
179:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
180:         {
181:           continue;
182:         }
183: 
184:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
185:         {
186:           oldest = desc;
187:         }
188:     }
189: 
190:   return oldest;
191: }
192: 
193: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
194: {
195:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
196:   int ret;
197: 
198:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
199:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
200:    */
201: 
202:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
203:     {
204:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
205:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
206:       g_processing_order = 0;
207:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
208:         {
209:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
210:           break;
211:         }
212: 
213:       desc->used = false;
214:     }
215: 
216:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
217:     {
218:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
219:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
220:       g_processing_order = 0;
221:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
222:         {
223:           break;
224:         }
225: 
226:       desc->used = false;
227:     }
228: }
229: 
230: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
231: {
232:   (void)irq;
233:   (void)context;
234:   (void)arg;
235: 
236:   mbox_clear_errors();
237: 
238:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
239:     {
240:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
241:       uint32_t address;
242:       uint32_t length;
243:       uint8_t source;
244: 
245:       mbox_process_desc();
246:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
247:       if (desc == NULL)
248:         {
249:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
250:           break;
251:         }
252: 
253:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
254:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
255:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
256:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
257:         {
258:           continue;
259:         }
260: 
261:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
262:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
263:              sizeof(desc->message));
264:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
265:       desc->used = true;
266:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
267:       mbox_process_desc();
268:     }
269: 
270:   mbox_process_desc();
271: 
272:   return OK;
273: }
274: 
275: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
276: {
277:   g_callback = callback;
278: }
279: 
280: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)
281: {
282:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
283: 
284:   (void)bk7258_mbox_irq(0, NULL, NULL);
285:   up_irq_restore(flags);
286: }
287: 
288: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
289: {
290:   unsigned int i;
291: 
292:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
293:     {
294:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
295:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
296:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
297:         {
298:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
299:         }
300:     }
301: }
302: 
303: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
304: {
305:   irqstate_t flags;
306: 
307:   if (stats == NULL)
308:     {
309:       return;
310:     }
311: 
312:   flags = up_irq_save();
313:   *stats = g_stats;
314:   up_irq_restore(flags);
315: }
316: 
317: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
318: {
319:   int ret;
320: 
321:   if (g_mbox_ready)
322:     {
323:       return OK;
324:     }
325: 
326:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
327:   g_rx_order = 0;
328:   g_processing_order = 0;
329:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
330: 
331:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
332:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
333:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
334:    */
335: 
336:   putreg32(2u | MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
337:            MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
338:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
339:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
340:   mbox_clear_errors();
341: 
342:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
343:   if (ret < 0)
344:     {
345:       return ret;
346:     }
347: 
348:   g_mbox_ready = true;
349:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
350:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
351:   return OK;
352: }

147: /****************************************************************************
148:  * Name: adjtime
149:  *
150:  * Description:
151:  *   The adjtime() function gradually adjusts the system clock (as returned
152:  *   by gettimeofday(2)).  The amount of time by which the clock is to be
153:  *   adjusted is specified in the structure pointed to by delta.
154:  *
155:  *   This structure has the following form:
156:  *
157:  *     struct timeval
158:  *       {
159:  *         time_t      tv_sec;     (seconds)
160:  *         suseconds_t tv_usec;    (microseconds)
161:  *       };
162:  *
163:  *   If the adjustment in delta is positive, then the system clock is
164:  *   speeded up by some small percentage (i.e., by adding a small amount of
165:  *   time to the clock value in each second) until the adjustment has been
166:  *   completed.  If the adjustment in delta is negative, then the clock is
167:  *   slowed down in a similar fashion.
168:  *
169:  *   If a clock adjustment from an earlier adjtime() call is already in
170:  *   progress at the time of a later adjtime() call, and delta is not NULL
171:  *   for the later call, then the earlier adjustment is stopped, but any
172:  *   already completed part of that adjustment is not undone.
173:  *
174:  *   If olddelta is not NULL, then the buffer that it points to is used to
175:  *   return the amount of time remaining from any previous adjustment that
176:  *   has not yet been completed.
177:  *
178:  *   NOTE: This is not a POSIX interface but derives from 4.3BSD, System V.
179:  *   It is also supported for Linux compatibility.
180:  *
181:  ****************************************************************************/
182: 
183: int adjtime(FAR const struct timeval *delta, FAR struct timeval *olddelta)
184: {
185:   irqstate_t flags;
186:   long adjust_usec;
187: 
188:   if (!delta)
189:     {
190:       set_errno(EINVAL);
191:       return -1;
192:     }
193: 
194:   flags = spin_lock_irqsave(&g_clock_lock);
195: 
196:   adjust_usec = delta->tv_sec * USEC_PER_SEC + delta->tv_usec;
197: 
198:   if (olddelta)
199:     {
200:       olddelta->tv_usec = g_clock_adjust;
201:     }
202: 
203:   g_clock_adjust = adjust_usec;
204: 
205:   spin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_clock_lock, flags);
206: 
207:   return OK;
208: }

text:
**Scope**

Research only. No files were changed. I excluded the CP 480 MHz vote implementation details as requested.

**Concrete Findings**

1. **P1 has no mechanism to wake for the next NuttX deadline.**  
Plan lines [347-355](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:347), [383](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:383), and [711-718](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:711) stop SysTick, keep `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS` disabled, and only describe reading elapsed AON time after an external wake. A pending `nxsig_usleep()` or watchdog cannot itself wake the AP, so it can oversleep indefinitely.

Vendor AP solves the analogous problem with tickless operation: `CONFIG_FREERTOS_USE_TICKLESS_IDLE=1` at [app_ab AP config:419](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap/config/bk7258_ap/config:419), and the primary SysTick handler derives elapsed ticks from AON time at [port.c:694](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/os_source/freertos_smp_v2p0/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/GCC/ARM_CM33_NTZ/non_secure/port.c:694). NuttX’s tickless contract requires an interval timer or alarm plus an elapsed-time counter at [time_clock.rst:332](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/Documentation/reference/os/time_clock.rst:332).

Suggested replacement:

> P1 must provide a wake deadline. Either retain periodic semantics by programming an AON/CP wake no later than the next 1 ms tick, or enable `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS` and implement the complete `up_timer_tick_cancel()`/`up_timer_tick_start()` or alarm backend using an AON compare/wakeup source. Strong time-read hooks alone do not create a wake event.

2. **P1 omits the existing NuttX SMP PM framework and its mandatory configuration.**  
Plan lines [339-348](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:339) invent a “CPU0 owner PM barrier,” but the contest NuttX already provides `pm_idle()`, `pm_idle_unlock()`, and `pm_idle_lock()` specifically for SMP WFI coordination at [pm.h:150](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/power/pm.h:150) and [pm.h:910](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/power/pm.h:910). Its implementation coordinates cores with SMP calls at [pm_idle.c:197](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/power/pm/pm_idle.c:197).

The current contest configuration has `CONFIG_PM` disabled at [.config:755](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/.config:755), and the plan’s target config at lines [370-384](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:370) never adds it. For two CPUs, `pm_idle.c` statically requires at least three domains at [pm_idle.c:37](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/power/pm/pm_idle.c:37).

Suggested replacement:

> P1 adds `CONFIG_PM=y`, a selected PM governor, `CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3`, and preferably `CONFIG_PM_SMP_LAST_CPU_INDEX=0` so logical CPU0/physical CPU1 performs the global AP transition. Implement BK7258 low voltage inside a `pm_idle(handler)` SMP handler; register driver `struct pm_callback_s` prepare/notify callbacks with `pm_register()`.

Also replace “CPU0 owner” with “NuttX logical CPU0, physical CPU1”; otherwise it is confused with physical CPU0/CP.

3. **P0’s promised WFI does not currently exist.**  
Plan lines [313-323](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:313) and [790](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:790) assume both idle loops execute WFI. BK7258 has no chip-specific idle source, so it inherits common ARM `up_idle()`, where WFI is disabled by `#if 0` at [arm_idle.c:47](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/common/arm_idle.c:47).

Suggested replacement:

> P0 adds a BK7258 `up_idle()` implementation, built by both Make and CMake, which clears `SCB_SCR_SLEEPDEEP`, executes `DSB; WFI; ISB`, and never sets AON low-voltage-ready bits. Verify both logical CPUs enter and leave this hook.

4. **“Clear the CPU1 sleep vote” is ambiguous and the current CP initialization sets the opposite state.**  
Plan lines [319](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:319) and [325-327](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:325) should name the actual operation. Vendor API semantics are `1 = enter sleep`, `0 = exit sleep` at [pm.h:1197](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/modules/pm.h:1197) and [pm.c:984](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c:984). `pm_sleep_vote_init()` initializes CPU1 to state `1` because CPU1 is in the required-module list at [pm.h:430](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/modules/pm.h:430) and initialization votes `1` at [pm.h:1277](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/modules/pm.h:1277). The existing startup clear is compiled only when `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` is enabled at [pwr_clk.c:331](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:331), while `app_ab` disables that option at [CP config:950](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:950).

Suggested replacement:

> On every OpenVela AP startup and recovery, CP must explicitly call `bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0)` and verify `BK_OK`. Do this independently of `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV`. State `0` means AP active/not ready for low voltage.

5. **Per-CPU interrupt-stack support is not complete enough to link an ARMv8-M SMP build.**  
Plan lines [377](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:377), [463](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:463), and [478](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:478) allocate two stacks but omit the required BK7258 `up_get_intstackbase(cpu)` implementation. Common ARM only defines it for `CONFIG_UP` at [arm_getintstack.c:37](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/common/arm_getintstack.c:37), and common exception assembly deliberately does not allocate `g_intstackalloc` under SMP at [arm_exception.S:349](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_exception.S:349). ARMv8-M `arm_initialize_stack()` calls `up_get_intstackbase(this_cpu())` at [arm_initialstate.c:191](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_initialstate.c:191). RP2040 supplies the missing model at [rp2040_irq.c:49](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/rp2040/rp2040_irq.c:49) and [rp2040_irq.c:450](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/rp2040/rp2040_irq.c:450).

Suggested replacement:

> Allocate `CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS * INTSTACK_SIZE` aligned bytes and implement `uintptr_t up_get_intstackbase(int cpu)`. The secondary naked entry sets its idle TCB stack as PSP/PSPLIM, then calls `arm_initialize_stack()` to install that CPU’s MSP/MSPLIM interrupt stack before enabling interrupts.

6. **`sched_note_cpu_started()` is not an online handshake, and `nx_smp_start()` is not an application call.**  
Plan line [508](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:508) lists `sched_note_cpu_started()` beside the online flag. That API compiles to nothing unless SMP switch instrumentation and the note driver are enabled at [sched_note.h:429](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/sched_note.h:429). The actual handshake must be the plan’s explicit shared online flag with release/acquire ordering.

Plan line [232](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:232) depicts CPU1 explicitly calling `nx_smp_start()`. NuttX invokes it internally from `nx_start()` at [nx_start.c:805](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:805), after `up_cpu_idlestack()` has initialized CPU1’s idle TCB at [nx_start.c:450](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:450).

Suggested replacement:

> `nx_start()` internally calls `nx_smp_start()`, which calls `up_cpu_start(1)`. Secondary publishes a release-ordered online flag after private architecture initialization; primary waits with acquire semantics. `sched_note_cpu_started()` is optional tracing only.

7. **The atomic wording overstates what `CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK` guarantees.**  
Plan lines [605-618](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:605) claim the gate arbitrates all `__atomic_*` fallback. The symbol exists at [machine/Kconfig:18](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/libs/libc/machine/Kconfig:18) and selects `arch_atomic.c`, whose out-of-line operations use `g_atomic_hwspinlock` at [arch_atomic.c:324](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/libs/libc/machine/arch_atomic.c:324). The required object is a `struct hwspinlock_dev_s` with `trylock/relax/unlock` operations, not merely a word, at [hwspinlock.h:40](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/hwspinlock/hwspinlock.h:40).

It does not prevent source outside NuttX’s `atomic_*` API from using compiler-inlined `__atomic_*`/exclusive instructions. The current toolchain path maps NuttX atomics directly to compiler builtins at [compiler.h:656](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/compiler.h:656). Vendor comments confirm that only exclusive lock objects belong in the special section and explain silent DMA/Audio write loss at [spinlock.c:272](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/spinlock/spinlock.c:272).

Suggested replacement:

> `CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK` routes NuttX `atomic_*` and libc out-of-line atomic helpers through a BK7258 `hwspinlock_dev_s`; only the gate word performs LDAXR/STXR in AP_SPINLOCK. Ban or audit direct compiler `__atomic_*`, `__sync_*`, and handwritten exclusive operations. Disassemble all SMP objects and fail the build if exclusive loops exist outside the approved gate.

8. **AON RTC is implementable, but “wrap extension” does not match the selected 64-bit implementation.**  
Plan lines [350-353](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:350) require “AON RTC wrap extension.” `app_ab` enables `CONFIG_AON_RTC_64BIT=y` at [AP config:1181](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap/config/bk7258_ap/config:1181). The vendor driver reads hardware low and high words repeatedly until stable at [aon_rtc_driver_64bit.c:214](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/rtc/aon_rtc_driver_64bit.c:214); register offsets are at [aon_rtc_driver_64bit.h:33](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/rtc/aon_rtc_driver_64bit.h:33). Conversion must distinguish internal 32,000 Hz from external 32,768 Hz at [aon_rtc_types.h:28](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/aon_rtc_types.h:28).

No AON RTC definitions or implementation currently exist in the contest BK7258 AP chip directory.

Suggested replacement:

> Port a read-only BK7258 AON counter helper using the stable low/high reread algorithm. Under the verified 64-bit hardware-counter mode, no software 32-bit wrap extension is required. Obtain or validate the active 32 kHz source from the CP contract, convert with 64-bit arithmetic, establish an AP monotonic epoch, and prove monotonicity across low-voltage entry/exit and counter rollover.

9. **The timer-hook wording needs to separate time reads from expiration processing.**  
The named strong hooks do exist at [arch.h:2020](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/arch.h:2020), but current weak implementations derive time from SysTick-maintained `g_timer.timebase` at [arch_timer.c:97](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/timers/arch_timer.c:97) and [arch_timer.c:265](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/timers/arch_timer.c:265). `clock_systime_ticks()` will use a strong `up_timer_gettick()` under `CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH` at [clock_systime_ticks.c:89](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/sched/clock/clock_systime_ticks.c:89), and the next timer processing pass evaluates watchdogs against that returned time at [sched_processtimer.c:179](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/sched/sched/sched_processtimer.c:179).

Suggested replacement:

> Implement strong `up_timer_gettick()` and `up_timer_gettime()` from the same AON epoch and restart SysTick only after clocks are stable. Before releasing the PM barrier, force or await one CPU0 timer-processing pass so expired watchdogs and sleeps are serviced. Separately implement the wake-deadline mechanism described above; elapsed-time reads are not a wake source.

10. **CPU2 power ownership needs a two-level distinction.**  
Plan lines [211-212](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:211) assign the CPU2 power domain to CP, while lines [486-494](/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md:486) have AP write `CPU2_PWR_DW=0`. Vendor code does both: CP PM owns `PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2` accounting at [pwr_clk.c:580](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:580), while the AP reset helper writes the CPU2 core-local `pwr_dw`, event select, boot offset, and reset controls at [system_main.c:205](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:205).

Suggested replacement:

> CP owns the CPU2 PM power-domain vote. After CP confirms that vote is ON, AP logical CPU0 may program the CPU2 core-control register’s local `pwr_dw=0`, RX event selection, boot offset, and reset-release fields. The AP register write must never substitute for or alter CP PM accounting.

**API And Config Verdict**

All plan-named NuttX SMP hooks exist with the stated core signatures: `up_cpu_start`, `up_cpu_idlestack`, `up_create_stack`, `up_send_smp_sched`, `up_send_smp_call`, `nxsched_smp_call_handler`, `nxsched_process_delivered`, and `nx_idle_trampoline`; see [arch.h:2330](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/arch.h:2330), [arch.h:2401](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/arch.h:2401), and [sched.h:1791](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/sched.h:1791). `nxsched_process_delivered()` is an internal scheduler API declared in [sched/sched.h:355](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/sched/sched/sched.h:355), so the BK chip implementation must retain access to the internal scheduler include path.

The listed Kconfig symbols also exist: `ARCH_HAVE_MULTICPU`, `SMP`, `SMP_NCPUS`, `SMP_DEFAULT_CPUSET`, `ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK`, `SYSTEM_TIME64`, `TIMER_ARCH`, `ARMV8M_SYSTICK`, `USEC_PER_TICK`, and `LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK`. The missing P1 symbols are `CONFIG_PM`, `CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3`, a PM governor, and an explicit timer wake-deadline design.

The broad vendor claims about two AON WFI bits, mailbox-only wake routing during coordinated sleep, and CP checking both bits are source-supported at [AP sys_pm_hal.c:844](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sys_pm_hal.c:844), [CP sys_pm_hal.c:865](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_pm_hal.c:865), and [CP sys_pm_hal.c:1172](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_pm_hal.c:1172). The main blockers are integration contracts, not absence of the underlying hardware mechanism.
